verdict.rationale: Signifyd is a commerce fraud-protection SaaS whose documented surface is REST APIs, webhooks, SDKs and device profiling. It is not an agent or assistant that consumes external tools, so acting as an MCP client is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any agent or MCP-client capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
